propositions: An unchanged prerequisite pinned under a supported historical fingerprint generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) is incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift when the latest fingerprint differs due to algorithm evolution, even though recomputation of current material under the historical generation exactly matches the signed pin.

The pin_health.derive_health function compares pins only against the latest fingerprint and lacks a compatibility predicate to recognize supported historical full-hash generations, unlike attest._legacy_material_ok which already performs this check for own-ticket material.

The attestation wrapper attest.derive_plan_material_pin_health supplies only current_material_fingerprint without the legacy compatibility check, causing false stale classifications for unchanged related material across fingerprint algorithm changes.

A fix must classify a mismatched latest fingerprint as current only when recomputing the current related ticket under a supported historical generation exactly matches the signed pin, while preserving all other health classifications and maintaining the enforcement that genuine unmatched hashes remain stale.
